traditional: Mercury sextile Venus: a soft contact. Communication, commerce, and contracts supports love, money, and pleasure — cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Mind meets charm. Speech and thought take on grace and an artistic flair. Only the conjunction and sextile are possible. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Smooth, pleasant, persuasive communication. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize thinking and connection into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what thinking and connection have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Diplomacy, the arts, and any work where pleasant, persuasive expression matters.
shadow: The ease lets scattered overthinking and indulgence and vanity go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
